summary: IdP metadata served with chunked transfer-encoding leads to truncated entityID and tenant resolution failures in private VPC
description:
Issue summary:
Customer's Private deployment intermittently fails tenant resolution during SSO flows. We see the IdP metadata XML being fetched by the identity-proxy but the entityID element is truncated. The proxy then fails to match the IdP entity to the configured tenant, resulting in immediate 401/403 responses for new SAML logins.

Impact:
- FinBank Analytics (private) unable to create new SSO sessions for some users; existing sessions remain valid.
- Affects onboarding and new user logins only; no data plane inference impact.
- Around 30% of IdP metadata fetches in the last 24h contained truncated payloads.

Environment:
- Private VPC deployment (FinBank Analytics) in us-west-2
- Identity-proxy v1.12.0 behind customer-managed ingress (NGINX)
- IdP endpoint: https://idp.finbank.example.com/metadata (IdP managed by customer)

Observed behavior:
- identity-proxy logs show SAML metadata parse errors and missing entityID.
- Error pattern correlates with upstream responses that include Transfer-Encoding: chunked.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Run a curl -v against the customer's metadata endpoint via the same path the proxy uses (through the ingress).
2) Intermittently the response headers contain 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' and the body is cut off mid-entityID.
3) Trigger SAML login flow; identity-proxy logs: 'metadata parse error: unexpected EOF while reading entityID' and the request returns 403 with tenant resolution failure in the response body.

Logs / excerpts:
- identity-proxy: "WARN metadata: parse failed: unexpected EOF at byte 312"
- ingress (NGINX): "upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream"
- curl capture: Response headers: Transfer-Encoding: chunked; Body length reported by client does not match parsed XML length.

Temporary workaround:
- Customer routing change: configure their IdP to serve metadata via Content-Length header (static file) or disable chunked responses on the IdP side. This reduces failures immediately.

Notes:
- This only appears in the private deployment where customer ingress terminates TLS and proxies to their IdP; hosted customers have not reported this.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) curl -v --location 'https://idp.finbank.example.com/metadata' via customer ingress path
2) Repeat until Transfer-Encoding: chunked appears in response headers
3) Attempt SAML login through the identity-proxy; observe 403 and metadata parse error in proxy logs
logs: identity-proxy WARN: metadata parse failed: unexpected EOF at byte 312; NGINX: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header; curl: <truncated XML showing incomplete <EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.finbank.example.com/sso/"...>
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: chunked transfer-encoding combined with ingress upstream behavior is causing partial reads by the identity-proxy HTTP client. Reproduced locally by instrumenting a mock IdP that returns chunked responses with occasional premature connection close.

Findings so far:
- identity-proxy HTTP client (Go net/http) was using default Read behavior; when upstream closes connection mid-stream the body reader returns EOF and the XML remains incomplete.
- Customer's ingress (NGINX) intermittently emits 'upstream prematurely closed connection' when backend IdP rotates worker processes during metadata generation.
- Linked to SUP-61502 (idp metadata fetch timeouts) as both involve metadata fetch instability, but root cause differs (timeouts vs chunked truncation).

Short-term mitigation applied:
- Instructed customer to set 'proxy_buffering off' and enable 'proxy_http_version 1.1' with 'proxy_set_header Connection ""' to avoid NGINX closing upstream prematurely. Customer applied change and saw immediate drop in truncation events.

Longer-term fix options:
- Harden identity-proxy metadata fetcher to retry and reassemble chunked responses, validating XML completeness before parsing. (PR created: related_github_prs).
- Add post-fetch validation and automated re-fetch on parse failure with exponential backoff.
resolution: Workaround: customer modified ingress settings to reduce upstream connection closes; this reduced errors. Engineering drafted a patch to identity-proxy to validate and retry on incomplete chunked responses (PR #482). Target: rollout patch to private branch and offer customer a hotfix deployment. Final verification pending after canary in customer's staging cluster.
